items.title: Disney Is Near Its High. Morgan Stanley Still Sees 14% Upside
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMorgan Stanley raised its Disney price target to $138 from $133 and kept its Overweight rating, after updating its estimates for Disney’s fiscal 2026 results. Disney beat its own guidance for fiscal 2026 and guided to double-digit adjusted EPS growth in fiscal 2027, excluding an extra week.

items.title: Josh Brown: Netflix Can Clear Wall Street’s 10.6% Growth Bar “Standing on Their Head”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysJosh Brown says Netflix can easily beat Wall Street’s 2027 revenue growth estimate, which sits below the 13% growth Netflix guides for 2026. At about 17x forward earnings, Netflix trades at roughly half its five-year average multiple, about Disney’s.

items.title: Trump's New Filing Reveals Nvidia, SpaceX And Tesla Purchases. White House Says He Didn't Direct Trades.
items.summary: Trump disclosed 751 securities transactions from September, including Nvidia, SpaceX, Tesla and Palantir purchases. The White House says independent managers control his investments.
